text_en: Preface Preface to the Recarved Record of Patriarch Zhaozhou I have heard of one who could ruin households and scatter estates, and at eighteen was skilled

text_zh: 聞夫破家散宅，於十八上而善 舞太阿；縱賓奪主，於賢聖前而 逢場作戲：一物不將來，便教放 下著；不起一念時，向道須彌山。 每拈一莖草而喚作丈六金身； 口惟一個齒而盡知世間滋味。 鎮州蘿蔔，諸方謾云即是師承； 青州布衫，學者休向言中取的。 一個老實頭，殺活臨機，頓超他 動棒用喝；三寸綿軟舌，縱橫自 在，何嘗用怪語奇言。其猶水上 按葫蘆，垂手東捺西捺；室中懸 寶鏡，任教凡來聖來。拈提向上 宗乘，念佛則漱口三日；善解拖 泥帶水，隨問而隨答有無。南泉真子、 馬祖的孫，其惟此老一人而已 矣。其垂跡也，滕蚐入口而糠食 自安；轉現報也，明珠出海而二 王供養，如此則寧非先佛示現 利生者哉！惜其語錄不能盡傳， 學者僅獲一帙，真如嘗鼎一臠、 飲海一滴者矣。柰舊刻歲久字 跡糢糊，吾徒明聲發心重刻詔 示後來，真報祖師之恩、深愜老 朽之意，因佳其志，聊綴數言。其 全機大用，非予劣智能解；造淵 洞微，自有通方作者。
text_en: in wielding the Tai'e sword; who let guest and host seize one another, and before worthies and sages made a play of every encounter: if not a single thing is brought forth, he simply tells one to put it down; when not a single thought arises, he points and says it is Mount Sumeru. Each time he picks up a single blade of grass and calls it the sixteen-foot golden body; with but a single tooth in his mouth, he fully knows all the flavors of the world. The turnip of Zhenzhou, people in all quarters idly say, is precisely his transmitted teaching; A Qingzhou cloth robe; students, do not seek the target within words. A plain and honest old fellow, killing and giving life according to the moment, suddenly surpassing those who wield sticks and shouts; with a soft tongue of three inches, freely at ease in all directions, when did he ever use strange words or bizarre speech? It is like pressing down a gourd on water, lowering the hand and pressing east, pressing west; in the room hangs a precious mirror, letting commoners come or sages come. When raising up the supreme vehicle of the lineage, if one speaks of Buddha-recitation he would rinse his mouth for three days; well able to drag mud and carry water, answering being and nonbeing. The true son of Nanquan, As asked, so it follows. the grandson of Mazu, was only this old man alone indeed. In his manifested traces, worms entered his mouth and he ate chaff and was at peace; in the turning of karmic recompense, a bright pearl emerged from the sea and the two kings made offerings. If so, how could he not be an ancient Buddha manifested for the benefit of beings? It is a pity his recorded sayings could not all be transmitted, and students obtained only one fascicle, truly like tasting one morsel from a cauldron, or drinking a single drop from the sea. But the old printing, after many years, has characters blurred and indistinct, so our disciple Mingsheng brought forth the resolve to recut and make it known for later generations. This truly repays the Patriarch's kindness and deeply accords with this old worn one's intention. Admiring his aspiration, I have casually appended a few words. As for his complete functioning and great activity, my poor intelligence cannot explain it; reaching depths and penetrating subtleties, there are naturally masters of broad understanding for that.
Yunmen, 27th generation transmitter of the orthodox Caodong lineage,

text_zh: 師離㴲水、動王侯心，印光潛、麈尾收，碧落霧霾松領 月，滄溟浪覆濟人舟，一燈乍滅波旬喜，雙眼重昏道 侶愁，縱是了然雲外客，每瞻瓶杌淚還流。
text_en: and moon, on the vast deep waves cover the ferrying boat. One lamp suddenly goes out and Mara rejoices; both eyes grow dim again and fellow practitioners grieve. Though one be a lucid traveler beyond the clouds, whenever gazing at the bottle and seat, tears still flow.
The Buddha-sun tilts west, the Patriarch-seal jewel is lost; the cinnabar pool sinks, the moon sinks in radiance, shadows spread through the abbot's room with furnace smoke

text_zh: 佛日西傾、祖印隳珠，沉丹沼、月沉輝，影敷丈室爐煙 慘，風起禪堂松韻微，隻履乍來留化跡，五天何處又 逢歸，解空弟子絕悲喜，猶自潸然對雪幃。
text_en: in gloom; wind rises in the meditation hall, the pine tones are faint. A single sandal once came and left traces of transformation; in what place of the five Indias shall we again meet his return? The disciple who understands emptiness cuts off sorrow and joy, yet still sheds tears before the snowy curtain.

text_zh: 師問南泉：「如何是道？」泉云：「平常心是。」師云：「還可趣向 不？」泉云：「擬即乖。」師云：「不擬，爭知是道？」泉云：「道不屬知、 不知。知是妄覺、不知是無記。若真達不疑之道，猶如 太虛廓然蕩豁，豈可強是非也。」師於言下頓悟玄旨， 心如朗月。
text_en: or pursued? Quan said, If you intend it, you deviate. The Master said, If one does not intend, how does one know it is the Way? Quan said, The Way does not belong to knowing or not knowing. Knowing is false awareness; not knowing is blankness. If one truly reaches the undoubting Way, it is like great empty space, vast and open and unobstructed. How could one force right and wrong upon it? At these words the Master suddenly awakened to the mysterious meaning, his mind like a bright moon.
Nanquan ascended the hall. The Master asked, Does the bright side accord, or does the dark side accord? Quan immediately returned to his room. The Master then left the

text_zh: 南泉上堂，師問：「明頭合？暗頭合？」泉便歸方丈。師便下 堂，云：「這老和尚被我一問，直得無言可對。」首座云：「莫 道和尚無語，自是上座不會。」師便打，又云：「這棒合是 堂頭老漢喫。」
text_en: hall and said, This old master, once I asked him, was left with no words to answer. The head monk said, Do not say the master had no words; it is only that you do not understand. The Master struck him and then said, This blow ought to be for the old man in the abbot's seat to take.
The Master asked Nanquan, Where does one who knows there is such a thing go? Quan said, To the patron's house in front of the mountain

text_zh: 師問南泉：「知有底人向什麼處去？」泉云：「山前檀越家 作一頭水牯牛去。」師云：「謝和尚指示。」泉云：「昨夜三更 月到窗。」
text_en: to become a water buffalo. The Master said, Thank you, master, for the instruction. Quan said, Last night at the third watch the moon came to the window.
While the Master served as stove attendant at Nanquan's, the assembly was on a communal work shift picking vegetables. The Master shouted inside the hall, Fire!

text_zh: 師在南泉作爐頭，大眾普請擇菜，師在堂內叫：「救火！ 救火！」大眾一時到僧堂前，師乃關卻僧堂門。大眾無 對，泉乃拋鎖匙從窗內入堂中，師便開門。
text_en: Fire! The whole assembly rushed at once to the monks' hall, and the Master then shut the hall door. The assembly had no reply. Quan then tossed the key through the window into the hall, and the Master opened the door.
The Master was drawing water at Nanquan's well tower. Seeing Nanquan pass by, he grabbed a post and hung up his feet,

text_zh: 師在南泉井樓上打水，次見南泉過，便抱柱懸卻腳 云：「相救！相救！」南泉上楜梯云：「一二三四五。」師少時間 卻去禮謝云：「適來謝和尚相救。」
text_en: saying, Save me! Save me! Nanquan climbed the ladder and said, One, two, three, four, five. After a little while the Master came down, bowed in thanks, and said, I thank master for just now saving me.
Nanquan's east and west halls were disputing over a cat. Quan came into the hall, lifted up the cat, and said, If you can speak it,

text_zh: 南泉東西兩堂爭貓兒，泉來堂內，提起貓兒云：「道得 即不斬，道不得即斬卻。」大眾下語皆不契泉意，當時 即斬卻貓兒子。至晚間師從外歸來，問訊次，泉乃舉 前語子，云：「你作麼生救得貓兒？」師遂將一隻鞋戴在 頭上出去。泉云：「子若在，救得貓兒。」
text_en: I will not cut it; if you cannot speak it, I will cut it. The assembly's responses all failed to meet Quan's meaning, and at once he cut the cat. By evening the Master returned from outside. During greetings, Quan then raised the earlier matter and said, How would you have saved the cat? The Master then put one sandal on his head and went out. Quan said, If you had been there, the cat would have been saved.
The Master asked Nanquan, Difference I will not ask about. What is sameness? Quan placed both hands on the ground, and the Master

text_zh: 師問南泉：「異即不問。如何是類？」泉以兩手托地，師便 蹋倒，卻歸涅槃堂內叫：「悔！悔！」泉聞乃令人去問悔箇 什麼？師云：「悔不剩與兩蹋。」
text_en: kicked him over, then returned to the Nirvana Hall crying, Regret! Regret! Hearing this, Quan sent someone to ask, Regret what exactly? The Master said, I regret not giving him two more kicks.
Nanquan passed by the bathhouse and saw the bath attendant tending the fire. He asked, What are you doing? The man said, Heating the bath.

text_zh: 南泉從浴室裏過，見浴頭燒火，問云：「作什麼？」云：「燒浴。」 泉云：「記取來喚水牯牛浴。」浴頭應：「喏。」至晚間，浴頭入 方丈，泉問：「作什麼？」云：「請水牯牛去浴。」泉云：「將得繩索 來不？」浴頭無對。師來問訊泉，泉舉似師，師云：「某甲有 語。」泉便云：「還將得繩索來麼？」師便近前驀鼻便拽。泉 云：「是即是，太麤生。」
text_en: Quan said, Remember to come call the water buffalo for a bath. The bath attendant replied, Yes. That evening, the attendant entered the abbot's room. Quan asked, What are you doing? He said, Inviting the water buffalo to bathe. Quan said, Did you bring rope and halter or not? The bath attendant had no reply. The Master came to greet Quan, and Quan told him the story. The Master said, I have a word. Quan immediately said, Did you bring rope and halter? The Master stepped forward and suddenly grabbed Quan's nose and pulled. Quan said, Yes, yes, but too rough.
The Master asked Nanquan, Beyond the four propositions and apart from the hundred negations, please speak, Master. Quan then returned to his room. The Master

text_zh: 師問南泉：「離四句、絕百非外，請師道。」泉便歸方丈。師 云：「這老和尚每常口爬爬地，及其問著，一言不措。」侍 者云：「莫道和尚無語好。」師便打一掌。南泉便掩卻方 丈門，便把灰圍卻，問僧云：「道得即開門。」多有人下語 並不契泉意，師云：「蒼天！蒼天！」泉便開門。
text_en: said, This old master is usually so glib, but when actually questioned, he cannot set forth a single word. The attendant said, Do not say the master has no words. The Master slapped him. Nanquan then shut the abbot's room door, made a ring of ashes around it, and asked the monks, If you can speak it, I will open the door. Many gave responses but none accorded with Quan's meaning. The Master said, Blue heaven! Blue heaven! Quan then opened the door.
The Master asked Nanquan, Mind is not Buddha, wisdom is not the Way. Is there still fault in this or not? Quan said,

text_zh: 師問南泉云：「心不是佛、智不是道，還有過也無？」泉云： 「有。」師云：「過在什麼處？請師道。」泉遂舉，師便出去。
text_en: There is. The Master said, Where is the fault? Please speak, Master. Quan was about to raise it, and the Master immediately left.
The Master ascended the hall and told the assembly: This matter is exact and direct; even great people of immeasurable stature cannot get out of it. This old monk

text_zh: 師上堂謂眾曰：「此事的的，沒量大人出這裏不得。老 僧到溈山，僧問：『如何是祖師西來意？』溈山云：『與我將 床子來。』若是宗師，須以本分事接人始得。」時有僧問： 「如何是祖師西來意？」師云：「庭前柏樹子。」學云：「和尚莫 將境示人。」師云：「我不將境示人。」云：「如何是祖師西來 意？」師云：「庭前柏樹子。」師又云：「老僧九十年前見馬祖 大師下八十餘員善知識，箇箇俱是作家，不似如今 知識枝蔓上生枝蔓，都大是去聖遙遠，一代不如一 代。只如南泉尋常道：『須向異類中行。』且作麼生會？如 今黃口小兒向十字街頭說葛藤，博飯噇、覓禮拜，聚 三五百眾。云：『我是善知識，你是學人。』」
text_en: once went to Guishan, where a monk asked, What is the Patriarch's meaning in coming from the West? Guishan said, Bring me the chair. If one is truly a lineage master, one must receive people with the fundamental matter. Then a monk asked: What is the Patriarch's meaning in coming from the West? The Master said, The cypress tree in the courtyard. The student said, master, do not use an object to instruct people. The Master said, I am not using an object to instruct people. He said, What is the Patriarch's meaning in coming from the West? The Master said, The cypress tree in the courtyard. The Master also said, Ninety years ago this old monk saw under Master Mazu more than eighty good teachers, every one of them a true adept, unlike the teachers of today who grow branches upon branches, all greatly far removed from the sages. Each generation is worse than the last. For example, Nanquan always said, One must proceed among those of a different kind. But how do you understand that? Now yellow-mouthed youngsters stand at crossroads spinning vines of talk, angling for food and seeking bows, gathering three or five hundred people, saying, I am a good teacher, you are students.
A monk asked, What is a pure monastery? The Master said, A girl with hair in two horns. What is the person in the monastery?

text_zh: 僧問：「如何是清淨伽籃？」師云：「丫角女子。」「如何是伽籃 中人？」師云：「丫角女子有孕。」
text_en: The Master said, A girl with hair in two horns who is pregnant.
A monk asked, I have heard that master personally saw Nanquan, is that so? The Master said, Zhenzhou produces big radishes.

text_zh: 問：「承聞和尚親見南泉是否？」師云：「鎮州出大蘿蔔頭。」
text_en: A monk asked, Where is master's native place? The Master pointed with his hand and said, West, and farther west.

text_zh: 問：「和尚生緣什麼處？」師以手指，云：「西邊更向西。」
text_en: A monk asked, The dharma has no separate dharma; what is dharma? The Master said, Outer emptiness, inner emptiness, inner-and-outer emptiness.

text_zh: 問：「法無別法，如何是法？」師云：「外空、內空、內外空。」
text_en: A monk asked, What is the Buddha's true Dharma-body? The Master said, What more is there to dislike?

text_zh: 問：「如何是佛真法身？」師云：「更嫌什麼。」
text_en: A monk asked, What is the mind-ground Dharma gate? The Master said, The pattern-board of past and present.

text_zh: 問：「如何是心地法門？」師云：「古今牓樣。」
text_en: A monk asked, What is host within guest? The Master said, This mountain monk does not ask about wives. What is guest within host?

text_zh: 問：「如何是賓中主？」師云：「山僧不問婦。」「如何是主中賓？」 師云：「老僧無丈人。」
text_en: The Master said, This old monk has no father-in-law.
A monk asked, What is the abiding permanence of all dharmas? The Master said, This old monk does not avoid speaking of the ancestors. The monk asked again,

text_zh: 問：「如何是一切法常住？」師云：「老僧不諱祖。」其僧再問， 師云：「今日不答話。」
text_en: and the Master said, Today I will not answer.
The Master ascended the hall and said: Brothers, do not stand long. If there is business, discuss it; if there is none, go sit beneath your robe and bowl

text_zh: 師上堂云：「兄弟！莫久立，有事商量，無事向衣缽下坐 窮理好。老僧行腳時，除二時齋粥是雜用心力處，餘 外更無別用心處也。若不如此，出家大遠在。」
text_en: and investigate thoroughly. When this old monk traveled, aside from the two meal times, which were places for mixed use of effort, all the rest had no other place to apply mind. If it is not like this, leaving home is far indeed.
A monk asked, Among all things, what is the hardest? The Master said, In mutual cursing, I yield you catching mouths; in mutual spitting, I yield you

text_zh: 問：「萬物中何物最堅？」師云：「相罵饒汝接觜，相唾饒汝 潑水。」
text_en: splashing water.
A monk asked, What about when it does not stop day or night? The Master said, Among monks there are no such twice-taxed commoners.

text_zh: 問：「曉夜不停時如何？」師云：「僧中無與麼兩稅百姓。」
text_en: A monk asked, What is the one phrase? The Master said, If you cling to one phrase, it will age you. The Master also said, If

text_zh: 問：「如何是一句？」師云：「若守著一句，老卻你。」師又云：「若 一生不離叢林，不語十年五載，無人喚你作啞漢，已 後佛也不奈你何。你若不信，截取老僧頭去。」
text_en: all your life you never leave the monastery grove and do not speak for ten years or five, no one will call you mute, and later even the Buddha will be unable to do anything with you. If you do not believe it, cut off this old monk's head.
The Master ascended the hall and said: Brothers, you are right in the third grievance. Therefore it is said, Only change the place where your former

text_zh: 師上堂云：「兄弟！你正在第三冤裏。所以道：『但改舊時 行履處，莫改舊時人。』共你各自家出家，比來無事，更 問禪問道，三十二十人聚頭來問，恰似欠伊禪道相 似。你喚作善知識，我是同受栲，老僧不是戲好，恐帶 累佗古人，所以東道西說。」
text_en: conduct was carried out; do not change the former person. You and I each left home on our own; lately with nothing to do, you furthermore ask about Chan and ask about the Way, thirty or twenty people gathering their heads to ask, just as if I owed them Chan and the Way. You call me a good teacher, but I am one receiving the cudgel together with you. This old monk does not joke for pleasure; I fear I may burden the ancient ones, and so I speak east and speak west.
A monk asked, How should one use mind throughout the twelve hours? The Master said, You are used by the twelve hours; this old monk uses

text_zh: 問：「十二時中如何用心？」師云：「你被十二時使，老僧使 得十二時。你問那箇時？」
text_en: the twelve hours. Which hour are you asking about?
A monk asked, What is the host of Zhaozhou? The Master barked, You barrel-hooping fellow. The student answered, Yes.

text_zh: 問：「如何是趙州主人公？」師咄云：「這箍桶漢。」學人應：「喏。」 師云：「如法箍桶著。」
text_en: The Master said, Hoop the barrel according to the rule.
A monk asked, What is the student's fundamental matter? The Master said, The tree shakes and birds scatter; fish are startled and the water turns muddy.

text_zh: 問：「如何是學人本分事？」師云：「樹搖鳥散，魚驚水渾。」
text_en: A monk asked, What is a person of little spirit? The Master said, This old monk is not equal to you. The student said, I do not claim victory.

text_zh: 問：「如何是少神底人？」師云：「老僧不如你。」學云：「不占勝。」 云：「你因什麼少神？」
text_en: The Master said, Then why are you of little spirit?
A monk asked, The supreme Way is not difficult, only it dislikes choosing and picking. Is this a den for people of the time? The Master said, Once someone asked me this,

text_zh: 問：「至道無難，唯嫌揀擇。是時人窠窟？」師云：「曾有問我， 直得五年分疏不得。」
text_en: and for five years straight I could not sort it out.
An official asked, When Danxia burned the wooden Buddha, why did the monastery steward's eyebrows and beard fall out? The Master said:

text_zh: 有官人問：「丹霞燒木佛，院主為什麼眉鬚墮落？」師云： 「官人宅中變生作熟，是什麼人？」云：「所使。」師云：「卻是佗 好手。」
text_en: In your household, who is it that turns the raw into cooked? The official said, The servant. The Master said, Then that is indeed his special skill.
A monk asked, When the seer Vimukta held Sudhana's hand and he saw Buddhas in motes of dust, how was it? The Master then grasped the monk's

text_zh: 問：「毗目僊人執善財手見微塵佛時如何？」師遂執僧 手云：「你見箇什麼？」
text_en: hand and said, What do you see?
A nun asked, What is the conduct of a śramaṇa? The Master said, Do not bear children. The nun said, master, do not engage

text_zh: 有尼問：「如何是沙門行？」師云：「莫生兒。」尼云：「和尚勿交 涉。」師云：「我若共你打交涉，堪作什麼？」
text_en: with me. The Master said, If I were to engage with you, what would I amount to?
A monk asked, What is the host of Zhaozhou? The Master said, A field-granary slave.

text_zh: 問：「如何是趙州主人公？」師云：「田厙奴。」
text_en: A monk asked, What is the king asking for xian-tuo-po? The Master said, Tell me, what do you say this old monk wants?

text_zh: 問：「如何是王索仙陀婆？」師云：「你道老僧要箇什麼？」
text_en: A monk asked, What is the mystery within mystery? The Master said, What mystery within mystery are you talking about? Seven within seven, eight within eight.

text_zh: 問：「如何玄中玄？」師云：「說什麼玄中玄？七中七、八中八。」
text_en: A monk asked, What is xian-tuo-po? The Master said, In quiet places, svaha.

text_zh: 問：「如何是仙陀婆？」師云：「靜處薩婆訶。」
text_en: A monk asked, What is dharma and non-dharma? The Master said, East, west, south, north. The student said, How should one understand it? The Master

text_zh: 問：「如何是法非法？」師云：「東西南北。」學云：「如何會去？」師 云：「上下四維。」
text_en: said, Up, down, and the four corners.
A monk asked, What is the mystery within mystery? The Master said, If that monk were still here, he would be seventy-four or seventy-five.

text_zh: 問：「如何是玄中玄？」師云：「這僧若在，合年七十四五。」
text_en: A monk asked, When the king asks for xian-tuo-po, then what? The Master suddenly rose, bowed, and folded his hands.

text_zh: 問：「王索仙陀婆時如何？」師驀起打躬叉手。
text_en: A monk asked, What is the Way? The Master said, I dare not, I dare not.

text_zh: 問：「如何是道？」師云：「不敢不敢。」
text_en: A monk asked, What is dharma? The Master said, Chik chik, she she.

text_zh: 問：「如何是法？」師云：「敕敕攝攝。」
text_en: A monk asked, How far is Zhaozhou from Zhenfu? The Master said, Three hundred. The student said, How far from Zhenfu to Zhaozhou

text_zh: 問：「趙州去鎮府多少？」師云：「三百。」學云：「鎮府來趙州多 少？」師云：「不隔。」
text_en: is it? The Master said, Not separated.
A monk asked, What is the mystery within mystery? The Master said, How long has mystery been here? The student said, Mystery has been here a long time.

text_zh: 問：「如何玄中玄？」師云：「玄來多少時也？」學云：「玄來久矣。」 師云：「賴遇老僧，洎合玄殺這屢生。」
text_en: The Master said, Good thing you met this old monk, otherwise mystery would have killed this many-times-born one.
A monk asked, What is the student's self? The Master said, Do you still see the cypress tree in the courtyard?

text_zh: 問：「如何是學人自己？」師云：「還見庭前柏樹子麼？」
text_en: The Master ascended the hall and said: If you are one who has long practiced, nothing is not real, nothing is not spanning ancient and present;

text_zh: 師上堂云：「若是久參底人，莫非真實、莫非亙古亙今； 若是新入眾底人，也須究理始得，莫趁者邊三百五 百一千，傍邊二眾叢林稱道好箇住持，洎乎問著佛 法，恰似炒砂作飯相似，無可施為、無可下口，卻言佗 非我是，面赫赤地，良由世間出非法語。真實欲明者 意，莫辜負老僧。」
text_en: if you are newly entered among the assembly, you too must investigate principle before it will do. Do not chase after this side's three hundred, five hundred, one thousand, with the two assemblies at the side and the monasteries praising, What a fine abbot. But when asked about the Buddha Dharma, it is just like frying sand to make rice: nothing can be done with it, nothing can be put in the mouth; yet they say others are wrong and I am right, their faces flushed red. This truly comes from worldly people uttering unlawful words. Those who truly wish to understand this meaning, do not let this old monk down.
A monk asked, In the world, speaking Dharma for all sages all belongs to draped forms; how doesmaster instruct people?

text_zh: 問：「在塵為諸聖說法總屬披搭，未審和尚如何示人？」 師云：「什麼處見老僧？」學云：「請和尚說。」師云：「一堂師僧 總不會這僧語話。」別有一僧問：「請和尚說。」師云：「你說 我聽。」
text_en: The Master said, Where do you see this old monk? The student said, Please speak, master. The Master said, The whole hall of monks and teachers does not understand this monk's words. Another monk asked, Please speak, master. The Master said, You speak, and I will listen.
A monk asked, When true transformation leaves no trace and there is no teacher and disciple, how is it? The Master said, Who told you to come ask? The student

text_zh: 問：「真化無跡，無師弟子時如何？」師云：「誰教你來問？」學 云：「更不是別人。」師便打之。
text_en: said, It was no one else. The Master then struck him.
A monk asked, How is this matter discerned? The Master said, I blame you. The student said, How can it be discerned? The Master said, I

text_zh: 問：「此事如何辨？」師云：「我怪你。」學云：「如何辨得？」師云：「我 怪你不辨。」學云：「還保任否？」師云：「保任不保任自看。」
text_en: blame you for not discerning. The student said, Should one preserve and verify it or not? The Master said, Preserve it or not, see for yourself.
A monk asked, What is a person without knowledge and understanding? The Master said, What matter are you talking about?

text_zh: 問：「如何是無知解底人？」師云：「說什麼事。」
text_en: A monk asked, What is the meaning of coming from the West? The Master got down from the meditation seat. The student said, Is that it or not? The Master said, This old

text_zh: 問：「如何是西來意？」師下禪床。學云：「莫便是否？」師云：「老 僧未有語在。」
text_en: monk has not yet spoken.
A monk asked, The Buddha-Dharma is long enduring; how should one use mind? The Master said, Did you see the Former Han and Later Han grasp and hold

text_zh: 問：「佛法久遠，如何用心？」師云：「你見前漢後漢把攬天 下，臨終時半錢也無分。」
text_en: the empire? At death they did not get even half a coin.
A monk asked, People of the world prize jewels; what does a śramaṇa prize? The Master said, Quickly shut your mouth.

text_zh: 問：「時人以珍寶為貴，沙門以何為貴？」師云：「急合取口。」 學云：「合口還得也無？」師云：「口若不合，爭能辨得？」
text_en: The student said, If I shut my mouth, is that right or not? The Master said, If your mouth is not shut, how can you discern it?
A monk asked, What is Zhaozhou's one phrase? The Master said, Not even half a phrase. The student said, Is there not even master

text_zh: 問：「如何是趙州一句？」師云：「半句也無。」學云：「豈無和尚 在？」師云：「老僧不是一句。」
text_en: here? The Master said, This old monk is not one phrase.
A monk asked, How can one avoid being deluded by circumstances? The Master dropped one foot down, and the monk immediately took off a shoe. The Master drew back

text_zh: 問：「如何得不被諸境惑？」師垂一足，僧便出鞋。師收起 足，僧無語。
text_en: his foot, and the monk had no words.
A lay official asked, When the Buddha was in the world, all beings took refuge in Buddha. After the Buddha's nirvana, all

text_zh: 有俗官問：「佛在日，一切眾生皈依佛。佛滅度後，一切 眾生歸依什麼處？」師云：「未有眾生。」學云：「現問次。」師云： 「更覓什麼佛？」
text_en: beings take refuge in what? The Master said, There are not yet any beings. The student said, I am asking right now. The Master said: What Buddha are you still looking for?
A monk asked, Is there anyone who does not repay the four favors and the three realms or not? The Master said, Yes. The student said, Who is it?

text_zh: 問：「還有不報四恩三有者也無？」師云：「有。」學云：「如何是？」 師云：「這殺父漢，算你只少此一問。」
text_en: The Master said, You father-killing fellow, count yourself as only lacking this one question.
A monk asked, What is master's meaning? The Master said, A place with no setting forth.

text_zh: 問：「如何是和尚意？」師云：「無施設處。」
text_en: The Master ascended the hall and said: Brothers, just amend the past and cultivate the future. If you do not amend, there are plenty of places that will stick to you.

text_zh: 師上堂云：「兄弟！但改往修來，若不改，大有著你處在。 老僧在此間三十餘年，未曾有一箇禪師到此間；設 有來，一宿一食急走過，且趁軟煖處去也。」 問：「忽遇禪師到來，向伊道什麼？」師云：「千鈞之弩不為 鼷鼠而發機。」師云：「兄弟！若從南方來者，即與下載；若 從北方來，即與裝載。所以道：『近上人問道即失道，近 下人問道者即得道。』兄弟！正人說邪法，邪法亦隨正； 邪人說正法，正法亦隨邪。諸方難見易識，我者裏易 見難識。」
text_en: This old monk has been here more than thirty years, and not once has a Chan master come here. Even if one does come, after one night and one meal he hurries off, chasing after some soft warm place. A monk asked, If suddenly a Chan master comes, what should one say to him? The Master said, A thousand-caty crossbow is not cocked for a mouse. The Master said, Brothers, if one comes from the south, then unload him; if one comes from the north, then load him. Therefore it is said: If those near the top ask the Way, they lose the Way; if those near the bottom ask the Way, they attain the Way. Brothers, when an upright person speaks deviant Dharma, the deviant Dharma also follows the upright; when a deviant person speaks right Dharma, the right Dharma also follows the deviant. In other places, hard to see and easy to recognize; here with me, easy to see and hard to recognize.
A monk asked, A person who cannot get hold of good and evil, can he be liberated alone or not? The Master said, Not liberated alone. The student said:

text_zh: 問：「善惡或不得底人，還獨脫也無？」師云：「不獨脫。」學云： 「為什麼不獨脫？」師云：「正在善惡裏。」
text_en: Why not liberated alone? The Master said, Right within good and evil.
A nun asked, Leaving aside what is said above, please instruct me, master. The Master barked, Smothered and broken iron bottle.

text_zh: 尼問：「離卻上來說處，請和尚指示。」師咄云：「煨破鐵瓶。」 尼將鐵瓶添水來：「請和尚答話。」師笑之。
text_en: The nun brought an iron bottle filled with water and said, Please answer, master. The Master laughed at her.
A monk asked, If the world turns into a black pit, on what road does this one fall? The Master said, Not taking a share. The student

text_zh: 問：「世界變為黑穴，未審此箇落在何路？」師云：「不占。」學 云：「不占是什麼人？」師云：「田厙奴。」
text_en: said, Who is the one not taking a share? The Master said, A field-granary slave.
A monk asked, Only when there is no speech and no intention does it count as a phrase. Since there is no speech, what is called a phrase? The Master said:

text_zh: 問：「無言無意始稱得句。既是無言，喚什麼作句？」師云： 「高而不危、滿而不溢。」學云：「即今和尚是滿是溢？」師云： 「爭奈你問我。」
text_en: High yet not precarious, full yet not overflowing. The student said, Right now is master full or overflowing? The Master said: What can I do about your asking me?
A monk asked, What is the numinous one? The Master said, On clean ground, a heap of shit. The student said, Please give the master's

text_zh: 問：「如何是靈者？」師云：「淨地上痾一堆屎。」學云：「請和尚 的旨。」師云：「莫惱亂老僧。」
text_en: true meaning. The Master said, Do not bother this old monk.
A monk asked, The Dharma-body is non-acting and does not fall into categories; is speech about it permitted or not? The Master said, How would you speak?

text_zh: 問：「法身無為不墮諸數，還許道也無？」師云：「作麼生道？」 學云：「與麼即不道也。」師笑之。
text_en: The student said, Then in that case it cannot be spoken. The Master laughed at him.
A monk asked, What is Buddha? What are sentient beings? The Master said, Sentient beings are Buddha, and Buddha is

text_zh: 問：「如何是佛？如何是眾生？」師云：「眾生即是佛，佛即是 眾生。」學云：「未審兩箇那箇是眾生？」師云：「問問。」
text_en: sentient beings. The student said, Of the two, which one is the sentient being? The Master said, Ask, ask.
A monk asked, The great Way has no root; how does one respond in chant? The Master said, You just respond in chant. He said, If it has no root, then how

text_zh: 問：「大道無根，如何接唱？」師云：「你便接唱。」云：「無根又作 麼生？」師云：「既是無根，什麼處繫縛你？」
text_en: can it be? The Master said, Since it is rootless, where can it bind you?
A monk asked, Can one truly practicing avoid being measured by ghosts and spirits or not? The Master said, They can measure him. He said, The fault

text_zh: 問：「正修行底人莫被鬼神測得也無？」師云：「測得。」云：「過 在什麼處？」師云：「過在覓處。」云：「與麼即不修行也？」師云： 「修行。」
text_en: lies where? The Master said, The fault lies in the seeking. He said, Then in that case there is no practice? The Master said: Practice.
A monk asked, The lone moon hangs in the sky; from where does its light arise? The Master said, From where does the moon arise?

text_zh: 問：「孤月當空，光從何生？」師云：「月從何生？」
text_en: A monk asked, I have heard master say: The Way does not belong to practice, only do not be defiled. What is non-defilement?

text_zh: 問：「承和尚有言：道不屬修，但莫染污。如何是不染污？」 師云：「檢校內外。」云：「還自檢校也無？」師云：「檢校。」云：「自己 有什麼過，自檢校？」師云：「你有什麼事？」
text_en: The Master said, Examine inside and outside. He said, Does one examine oneself too or not? The Master said, Examine. He said, What fault does oneself have, to examine oneself? The Master said, What business do you have?
The Master ascended the hall and said: This matter is like a bright jewel in the palm: when a Hu comes, a Hu appears; when a Han comes, a Han appears. This old

text_zh: 師上堂云：「此事如明珠在掌，胡來胡現、漢來漢現。老 僧把一枝草作丈六金身用，把丈六金身作一枝草 用。佛即是煩惱，煩惱即是佛。」問：「佛與誰人為煩惱？」師 云：「與一切人為煩惱。」云：「如何免得？」師云：「用免作麼？」
text_en: monk uses a blade of grass as a sixteen-foot golden body, and uses the sixteen-foot golden body as a blade of grass. Buddha is affliction, affliction is Buddha. A monk asked, For whom does Buddha become affliction? The Master said, For all people he becomes affliction. He said, How can one avoid it? The Master said, What use is avoidance?
The Master instructed the assembly, Here this old monk receives people with the fundamental matter. If you want this old monk to follow

text_zh: 師示眾云：「老僧此間即以本分事接人。若教老僧隨 伊根機接人，自有三乘十二分教接佗了也。若是不 會，是誰過歟？已後遇著作家漢，也道老僧不辜佗。但 有人問，以本分事接人。」
text_en: their faculties and capacities in receiving them, the Three Vehicles and the Twelve Divisions of Teaching already receive them well enough. If they do not understand, whose fault is it? Later, when you meet a true adept, you can also say this old monk did not wrong him. Whenever anyone asks, receive him with the fundamental matter.
A monk asked, From ancient times until now, mind itself is Buddha. If not mind itself, is a student still permitted to discuss it or not?

text_zh: 問：「從上至今，即心是佛。不即心，還許學人商量也無？」 師云：「即心且置，商量箇什麼？」
text_en: The Master said, Set aside mind itself for the moment; what is there to discuss?
A monk asked, If an ancient mirror is not polished, does it still reflect or not? The Master said, Former life is cause, this life is result.

text_zh: 問：「古鏡不磨，還照也無？」師云：「前生是因，今生是果。」
text_en: A monk asked, Before the three blades fall, how is it? The Master said, Dense and bristling. He said, After they fall, how is it? The Master said:

text_zh: 問：「三刀未落時如何？」師云：「森森地。」云：「落後如何？」師云： 「迥迥地。」
text_en: Far and open.
A monk asked, What is a person beyond the three realms? The Master said, Cannot be caged or covered.

text_zh: 問：「如何是出三界底人？」師云：「籠罩不得。」
text_en: A monk asked, Before Niutou met the Fourth Patriarch, a hundred birds brought flowers in offering; after meeting him, why did the hundred birds

text_zh: 問：「牛頭未見四祖，百鳥銜花供養；見後為什麼百鳥 不銜花供養？」師云：「應世、不應世。」
text_en: no longer bring flowers in offering? The Master said, Responding to the world, not responding to the world.
A monk asked, What is it like when white clouds are at ease? The Master said, How could it compare to spring wind idle everywhere?

text_zh: 問：「白雲自在時如何？」師云：「爭似春風處處閑。」
text_en: A monk asked, What is the white ox in the open field? The Master said, Under moonlight no color is needed. He said, What does it eat?

text_zh: 問：「如何是露地白牛？」師云：「月下不用色。」云：「食噉何物？」 師云：「古今嚼不著。」云：「請師答話。」師云：「老僧答與麼。」
text_en: The Master said, From ancient to present none can chew it. He said, Please answer, Master. The Master said, This old monk answers like this.
The Master instructed the assembly: If mind intends, it at once errs. A monk then asked, What about when mind does not intend? The Master struck him twice

text_zh: 師示眾云：「擬心即差。」僧便問：「不擬心時如何？」師打二 下云：「莫是老僧辜負闍梨麼？」
text_en: and said, Is it that this old monk has let you down, Ācārya?
A monk asked, Whenever there is question and answer, it falls into the faculty of mind; if it does not fall into the faculty of mind, how does the Master respond? The Master said, Ask.

text_zh: 問：「凡有問答，落在意根；不落意根，師如何對？」師云：「問。」 學云：「便請師道。」師云：「莫向這裏是非。」
text_en: The student said, Then please speak, Master. The Master said, Do not make right and wrong here.
A monk asked, When the dragon girl personally offered to the Buddha, what exactly did she offer? The Master made an offering gesture with both hands.

text_zh: 問：「龍女親獻佛，未審將什麼獻？」師以兩手作獻勢。
text_en: The Master instructed the assembly: Here the Buddha-Dharma, if called difficult is easy, if called easy is difficult. Elsewhere it is hard to see

text_zh: 師示眾云：「此間佛法道難即易、道易即難。別處難見 易識，老僧者裏即易見難識。若能會得，天下橫行。忽 有人問：『什麼處來？』若向伊道：『從趙州來。』又謗趙州；若 道：『不從趙州來。』又埋沒自己。諸人且作麼生對他？」僧 問：「觸目是謗和尚，如何得不謗去？」師云：「若道不謗，早 是謗了也。」
text_en: and easy to know; here with this old monk it is easy to see and hard to know. If you can understand it, you may roam freely under heaven. Suppose someone asks, From where do you come? If you say to him, From Zhaozhou, that slanders Zhaozhou; if you say, Not from Zhaozhou, that buries yourself. Everyone, how will you answer him? A monk asked, If whatever meets the eye slanders master, how can one avoid slandering? The Master said, If you say not slandering, already that is slander.
A monk asked, What is the right path of practice? The Master said, If you understand practice, that is enough. If you do not understand practice,

text_zh: 問：「如何是正修行路？」師云：「解修行即得。若不解修行， 即參差落佗因果裏。」又云：「我教你道。若有問時，但向 伊道：『趙州來。』忽問：『趙州說什麼法？』但向伊道：『寒即言 寒、熱即言熱。』若更問道：『不問者箇事。』但云：『問什麼事？』 若再問：『趙州說什麼法？』便向伊道：『和尚來時不教傳 語。上座若要知趙州事，但自去問取。』」
text_en: you fall unevenly into others' cause and effect. He also said, I will teach you what to say. If someone asks, just say to him: Zhaozhou comes. If he then asks, What Dharma does Zhaozhou teach? just say to him: When cold, speak of cold; when hot, speak of heat. If he further asks, I am not asking about that matter, then simply say: What matter are you asking about? If he asks again, What Dharma does Zhaozhou teach? then say to him: When master came, he did not tell me to pass on messages. If you want to know Zhaozhou's matter, just go and ask him yourself.
A monk asked, What about when one does not look before or after? The Master said, Setting aside not looking before or after, whom are you asking?

text_zh: 問：「不顧前後時如何？」師云：「不顧前後且置，你問阿誰？」

text_en: A monk asked, Then when the Second Patriarch obtained the marrow, how was it? The Master said, Do not slander the Second Patriarch. text_zh: 問：「學人全不會時如何？」師云：「我更不會。」云：「和尚還知 有也無？」師云：「我不是木頭，作麼不知？」云：「大好不會。」師 拍掌笑之。
text_en: or not? The master said, I am not wood; how could I not know? He said, Excellent not understanding. The master clapped his hands and laughed at him.
A monk asked, What is a person of the Way? The master said, I would say, a Buddha-person.

text_zh: 問：「如何是道人？」師云：「我向道是佛人。」
text_en: A monk asked, Whenever there are words and phrases, raising hands or moving feet, all of it falls into the student’s net. Apart from this, please

text_zh: 問：「凡有言句、舉手動足，盡落在學人網中。離此外，請 師道。」師云：「老僧齋了，未喫茶。」
text_en: master, speak. The master said, This old monk has eaten the meal, but has not yet had tea.

text_zh: 馬大夫問：「和尚還修行也無？」師云：「老僧若修行，即禍 事。」云：「和尚既不修行，教什麼人修行？」師云：「大夫是修 行底人？」云：「某甲何名修行？」師云：「若不修行，爭得撲在 人王位中？餧得來赤凍紅地，無有解出期？」大夫乃下 淚拜謝。
text_en: affair. He said, Since master does not cultivate, whom do you teach to cultivate? The master said, Magistrate, are you a person who cultivates? He said, How am I called a cultivator? The master said, If you do not cultivate, how did you get thrown into the kingly office among men? Fed into this red-frozen crimson ground, with no term for release? The magistrate then shed tears, bowed, and gave thanks.
The master instructed the assembly, saying, "Venerable, it is not that you did not bring it; this old monk is not one who does not respond." He also said:

text_zh: 師示眾云：「闍梨不是不將來，老僧不是不秪對。」又云： 「闍梨莫擎拳合掌，老僧不將禪床拂子對。」
text_en: Venerable, do not raise your fist or join your palms; this old monk will not answer with the Chan seat or the whisk.

text_zh: 問：「思憶不及處如何？」師云：「過者邊來。」云：「過者邊來即 是及處，如何是思不及處？」師豎起手云：「你喚作什麼？」 云：「喚作手。和尚喚作什麼？」師云：「百種名字我亦道。」云： 「不及和尚百種名字，且喚什麼？」師云：「與麼即你思憶 不及處。」僧禮拜，師云：「教你思憶得及者。」云：「如何是？」師 云：「釋迦教祖師教是你師。」云：「祖與佛，古人道了也。如 何是思憶不及處？」師再舉指云：「喚作什麼？」僧良久，師 云：「何不當頭道著，更疑什麼？」
text_en: exactly the reachable place. What is the place thought does not reach? The master raised his hand and said, What do you call this? He said, I call it a hand. What do you call it, master? The master said, I too can say a hundred names. He said: I cannot match master in a hundred names, but what do you call it then? The master said, Then this is your place where thought and memory do not reach. The monk bowed. The master said, I will teach you the place where thought and memory do reach. He said, What is it? The master said, Shakyamuni’s teaching and the Patriarchs’ teaching are your teachers. He said, Patriarchs and Buddhas, the ancients already spoke of them. What then is the place thought and memory do not reach? The master again raised his finger and said, What do you call this? The monk was silent for a long while. The master said, Why not speak it right on the spot? What more is there to doubt?
A monk asked, What is your family style, master? The master said, This old monk is hard of hearing. Ask louder. The monk asked again,

text_zh: 問：「如何是和尚家風？」師云：「老僧耳背，高聲問。」僧再問， 師云：「你問我家風，我卻識你家風。」
text_en: and the master said, You ask about my family style, but I recognize yours.
A monk asked, What when the myriad conditions all arise? The master said, The myriad conditions all arise. He said, One question and one answer is

text_zh: 問：「萬境俱起時如何？」師云：「萬境俱起。」云：「一問一答是 起，如何是不起？」師云：「禪床是不起底。」僧才禮拜次，師 云：「記得問答？」云：「記得。」師云：「試舉看？」僧擬舉。
text_en: arising. What is non-arising? The master said, The Chan seat is the non-arising one. As the monk was just about to bow, the master said, Do you remember the question and answer? He said, I remember. The master said, Try to state it. The monk was about to speak.
A monk asked, What is the Buddha before us? The master said, The one in the hall. He said, That is the form-Buddha; what

text_zh: 問：「如何是目前佛？」師云：「殿裏底。」云：「者箇是相貌佛，如 何是佛？」師云：「即心是。」云：「即心猶是限量。如何是佛？」師 云：「無心是。」學云：「有心無心還許學人揀也無？」師云：「有 心無心總被你揀了也，更教老僧道什麼即得？」
text_en: is Buddha? The master said, Mind itself is. He said, Mind itself is still limited. What is Buddha? The master said, No-mind is. The student said, Do you allow the student to choose between mind and no-mind or not? The master said, Mind and no-mind have both already been chosen by you. What more do you want this old monk to say?
A monk asked, I have come from far away to rely on the master; I wonder what your family style is? The master said, I do not speak it to people. The student said, Why

text_zh: 問：「遠遠投師，未審家風如何？」師云：「不說似人。」學云：「為 什麼不說似人？」師云：「是我家風。」學云：「和尚既不說似 人，爭奈四海來投？」師云：「你是道我不是海？」學云：「未審 海內事如何？」師云：「老僧釣得一箇。」
text_en: do you not speak it to people? The master said, That is my family style. The student said, Since master does not speak it to people, what about those who come from the four seas to rely on you? The master said, Are you saying I am not a sea? The student said, I wonder what the matters within the sea are like? The master said, This old monk has hooked one.
A monk asked, What kind of person is it that patriarchs and Buddhas cannot approach? The master said, Not patriarchs, not Buddhas. The student said, But

text_zh: 問：「祖佛近不得底是什麼人？」師云：「不是祖佛。」學云：「爭 奈近不得何？」師云：「向你道不是祖佛、不是眾生、不是 物，得麼。」學云：「是什麼？」師云：「若有名字，即是祖佛、眾生 也。」學云：「不可只與麼去也？」師云：「卒未與你去在。」
text_en: what about their not being able to approach? The master said, I tell you: not patriarchs, not Buddhas, not sentient beings, not things, is that enough? The student said, Then what is it? The master said, If it has a name, then it is patriarchs, Buddhas, sentient beings, and so on. The student said, It cannot just be left at that, can it? The master said, I have not yet let you go.
A monk asked, What is the ordinary mind? The master said, Foxes, wolves, and wild jackals.

text_zh: 問：「如何是平常心？」師云：「狐狼野干是。」

text_en: in the first place?

text_en: The monk answered. The master said, Come over to this side. The monk then came over and asked again, What is original color? The master said: For now, just follow the colors along.
A monk asked, Does a person of ordinary mind still receive instruction or not? The master said, I do not pass through another's gate.

text_zh: 問：「平常心底人還受教化也無？」師云：「我不歷佗門戶。」 學云：「與麼則莫沉卻那邊人麼？」師云：「大好平常心。」
text_en: The student said, If so, then would that not sink the person over there? The master said, Excellent ordinary mind.
A monk asked, What is the thing to be safeguarded in practice? The master said, Through the end of future ages, it cannot be picked out.

text_zh: 問：「如何是學保任底物？」師云：「盡未來際揀不出。」
text_en: A monk asked, What is a person of great cultivation? The master said, The temple officers are.

text_zh: 問：「如何是大修行底人？」師云：「寺裏綱維是。」
text_en: A monk asked, When a student has just arrived and knows nothing at all of the gate and threshold, what then? The master said, What is your name, Reverend?

text_zh: 問：「學人才到，總不知門戶頭事如何？」師云：「上座名什 麼？」學云：「惠南。」師云：「大好不知。」
text_en: The student said, Huinan. The master said, Fine indeed, not knowing.
A monk asked, This student wants to learn, yet he slanders the master; how can he avoid slandering? The master said, What is your name?

text_zh: 問：「學人欲學，又謗於和尚，如何得不謗去？」師云：「你名 什麼？」學云：「道皎。」師云：「靜處去，者米囤子。」
text_en: The student said, Daojiao. The master said, Go sit quietly, you rice bin.

text_zh: 問：「如何是和尚大意？」師云：「無大無小。」學云：「莫便是和 尚大意麼？」師云：「若有纖毫，萬劫不如。」
text_en: great meaning? The master said, If there is the slightest bit, then for ten thousand kalpas it will not do.
A monk asked, All dharmas are originally at rest, but people themselves make trouble. Whose words are these? The master said, Step out and you die.

text_zh: 問：「萬法本閑而人自鬧，是什麼人語？」師云：「出來便死。」

text_en: statement? The master said, Above heaven and below heaven, I alone am honored.
A monk asked, What is Vairocana's perfect circle? The master said, This old monk left home from youth and has never had failing eyes.

text_zh: 問：「如何是毘盧圓相？」師云：「老僧自小出家，不曾眼花。」 學云：「和尚還為人也無？」師云：「願你長見毘盧圓相。」
text_en: The student said, Does the master still teach people or not? The master said, May you always see Vairocana's perfect circle.

text_en: until now it all falls to this old monk. The student said, I do not know what is transmitted. The master said, Every one of them all belongs to birth and death. The monk said, You must not bury the patriarchs. The master said, Transmit what?

text_en: and patriarchs.

text_en: said, There are not two.
A monk asked, What is it like when no boundary or mark is seen? The master pointed to the clean bottle and said, What is this? The student said, A clean bottle.

text_zh: 問：「不見邊表時如何？」師指淨瓶云：「是什麼？」學云：「淨瓶。」 師云：「大好不見邊表。」
text_en: The master said, Excellent not seeing boundary marks.
A monk asked, What is returning to the root? The master said, The moment you intend it, you miss.

text_zh: 問：「如何是歸根？」師云：「擬即差。」
text_en: A monk asked, Without leaving words and phrases, how can one attain solitary liberation? The master said, Leaving words and phrases is solitary liberation. The student said:

text_zh: 問：「不離言句如何得獨脫？」師云：「離言句是獨脫。」學云： 「適來無人教某甲來。」師云：「因什麼到此？」學云：「和尚何 不揀出？」師云：「我早箇揀了也。」
text_en: Just now no one told me to come here. The master said, Then what brought you here? The student said, Why does the master not pick it out? The master said, I picked it out long ago.
A monk asked, Not mind and not identical with wisdom, please give one phrase, master. The master said, This old monk falls behind you.

text_zh: 問：「非心不即智，請和尚一句。」師云：「老僧落你後。」
text_en: A monk asked, What is the ultimate? The master said, The ultimate. The student said, Which one is the ultimate? The master said, This old

text_zh: 問：「如何是畢竟？」師云：「畢竟。」學云：「那箇畢竟是？」師云：「老 僧是畢竟，你不解問者話。」學云：「不是不問。」師云：「畢竟 在什麼處？」
text_en: monk is the ultimate; you do not understand how to ask this question. The student said, It is not that I do not ask. The master said, The ultimate is in what place?

text_zh: 問：「不挂寸絲時如何？」師云：「不挂什麼。」學云：「不挂寸絲。」 師云：「大好不挂寸絲。」
text_en: The master said, Excellent not hanging an inch of thread.

text_en: Do not occupy another's rank.

text_en: dharma do you preach? The master said, I preach what you asked.
A monk asked, It is said of old, empty clarity illumines itself. What is self-illumination? The master said, It is not called another's illumination.

text_zh: 問：「承古有言虛明自照，如何是自照？」師云：「不稱佗照。」 學云：「照不著處如何？」師云：「你話墮也。」
text_en: The student said, What about where illumination does not reach? The master said, Your words have fallen.
A monk asked, What is the target, the exact point? The master said, When not a single thought has arisen.

text_en: A monk asked, What is the Dharma King? The master said, The great king of the province is. The monk said, Is the master not? The master said:

text_en: Are you planning rebellion? Altogether you do not recognize even one king.

text_en: said, The master is certainly there, but can one still serve or not? The master said, You teach me and let me see.
A monk asked, Among the three bodies, which is the original body? The master said, Not one may be lacking.

text_en: A monk asked, I do not know who is patriarch in this land. The master said, Since Bodhidharma came here, all are so. The student said:

text_en: Which patriarchal generation is the master? The master said, I do not fall into rank. The student said, Where is it? The master said, In your ears.

text_en: said, This student has never left home. The master said, Take refuge in Buddha, take refuge in Dharma. The student said, I do not know whether there is even a home to leave or not. The master said, You must directly leave home. The student said, Where should one place it? The master said, For now, sit at home.

text_en: can one strike it? The master said, Do not use force. The student said, If one does not use force, how can one strike it? The master said, If you use force, you go astray.

text_en: if one cannot manage it? The master said, Whose fault is that? The student said, How should one undertake it? The master said, Nowadays no one can undertake it. The monk said, Then there is no support to rely on? The master said, Yet you cannot do without this old monk.
A monk asked, What about one who has finished the matter? The master said, Precisely great cultivation. The student said, I do not know whether the master still

text_en: enter. Cui said, If he is a great good spiritual friend, why enter hell? The master said, If this old monk did not enter, how could I get to see you, Vice Minister?

text_zh: 問：「毫釐有差時如何？」師云：「天地懸隔。」云：「毫釐無差時 如何？」師云：「天地懸隔。」
text_en: The master said, Heaven and earth are far apart.

text_zh: 師上堂，示眾：「金佛不度爐，木佛不度火，泥佛不度水， 真佛內裏坐。菩提、涅槃、真如、佛性，盡是貼體衣服，亦 名煩惱。不問即無煩惱，實際理地，什麼處著。一心不 生，萬法無咎。但究理而坐二三十年，若不會，截取老 僧頭去。夢幻空花，徒勞把捉；心若不異，萬法亦然。既 不從外得，更拘什麼？如羊相似，更亂拾物安口中作 麼？老僧見藥山和尚道：『有人問著，但交合取狗口。』老 僧亦道：『合取狗口。』取我是垢，不取我是淨；一似獵狗 相似，專欲得物喫。佛法向什麼處著？一千人萬人盡 是覓佛漢子，覓一箇道人無。若與空王為弟子，莫教 心病最難醫。未有世界，早有此性；世界壞時，此性不 壞。從一見老僧後，更不是別人，只是箇主人公。者箇 更向外覓作麼？與麼時，莫轉頭換面即失卻也。」
text_en: the true Buddha sits within. Bodhi, nirvana, suchness, Buddha-nature, all are clothes clinging to the body, and also are called afflictions. If one does not ask, there are no afflictions. In the ground of ultimate reality, where can anything be set? If one mind does not arise, the ten thousand dharmas are without fault. Just investigate the principle and sit for twenty or thirty years. If you do not understand, cut off this old monk's head and take it. Dreams, illusions, empty flowers are vainly grasped. text_en: is the site of awakening. Where is the lecturer? No reply. The master told Quanyi to answer in the lecturer's place. Quan- yi said, From this one question alone, can you recognize the site of awakening? The master said, Your body is in the site of awakening, your mind is where? Speak quickly! He said, master is not seeking the student's mind. The master said, I am. He said, This one question and one answer, what are they? The master said, This old monk is not in the mental factors; the Dharma passes beyond eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind, and is known and understood. He said, Since it is not among the mind's reckonings, why does master seek it? The master said, Because for your sake I cannot say it. He said, If the Dharma passes beyond eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind and is not understood, how can you say it cannot be said? The master said, Eat my phlegm and spittle.

text_en: place can one stay in? Yunju said, Ahead there is the foundation of an old temple. The master said, Then, master, find a place to stay yourself." The master again went to Zhuyu. Zhuyu said, "Why take a fall on level ground?" The master said, "Only because my mind is coarse."

In the hall there were two monks, each pushing the other away and refusing to be first seat. The steward reported this to the master. The master said,

text_zh: 堂中有二僧，相推不肯作第一座，主事白和尚，師云： 「總教他作第二座。」云：「教誰作第一座？」師云：「裝香著。」云： 「裝香了也。」師云：「戒香定香。」
text_en: "Make them both second seat." He asked, "Then who should be first seat?" The master said, "Set out the incense." He said, "The incense has already been set out." The master said, "The incense of precepts, the incense of concentration."
The master asked a monk, "Where have you come from?" He said, "From the capital." The master said, "Did you pass through Tong Pass?"

text_zh: 師問僧：「離什麼處？」云：「離京中。」師云：「你還從潼關過麼？」 云：「不歷。」師云：「今日捉得者販私鹽漢。」
text_en: He said, "I did not pass through it." The master said, "Today I have caught a smuggler of illicit salt."
While seeing off a deceased monk, the master said, "It is only one dead man, yet countless people escort him." He also said, "So many

text_zh: 因送亡僧，師云：「只是一箇死人，得無量人送。」又云：「許 多死漢，送一箇生漢。」時有僧問：「是心生，是身生？」師云： 「身心俱不生。」云：「者箇作什麼？」師云：「死漢。」
text_en: dead men escort one living man." At that time a monk asked, "Is it the mind that lives, or the body that lives?" The master said, "Body and mind both do not live." He said, "Then what is this?" The master said, "A dead fellow."
A monk saw a cat and asked, "I call it a cat; what does the master call it,

text_zh: 有僧見貓兒，問云：「某甲喚作貓兒，未審和尚喚作什 麼？」師云：「是你喚作貓兒。」
text_en: I wonder?" The master said, "It is you who call it a cat."
When the king of Zhenzhou came to visit the master, the attendant came to report, saying, "The king has come." The master said, "May the king

text_zh: 因鎮州大王來訪師，侍者來報師，云：「大王來。」師云：「大 王萬福。」侍者云：「未在，方到三門下。」師云：「又道大王來 也。」
text_en: have ten thousand blessings." The attendant said, "He is not here yet; he has only reached below the gate." The master said, "And yet you say the king has come."
From atop the east privy he called for Wenyuan, and Wenyuan answered. The master said, "Up on the east privy, I cannot speak

text_zh: 因上東司召文遠，文遠應喏。師云：「東司上，不可與你 說佛法也。」
text_en: Buddhist teaching with you."
While passing through the hall, he called the attendant, and the attendant answered. The master said, "What fine hall-merit."

text_zh: 因在殿上過，乃喚侍者，侍者應喏。師云：「好一殿功德。」 侍者無對。
text_en: The attendant had no reply.
When the master went to Linji's place, he had just begun washing his feet when Linji asked, "What is the meaning of the Patriarch's coming from the West?"

text_zh: 師因到臨濟，方始洗腳，臨濟便問：「如何是祖師西來 意？」師云：「正值洗腳。」臨濟乃近前側聆，師云：「若會便會， 不會更莫啗啄，作麼？」臨濟拂袖去，師云：「三十年行腳， 今日為人錯下注腳。」
text_en: The master said, "I am right in the middle of washing my feet." Linji came closer and leaned over to listen. The master said, "If you understand, then understand. If you do not, do not peck at it any further, what are you doing?" Linji flicked his sleeves and left. The master said, "After thirty years of pilgrimage, today I have put a mistaken note under someone's foot."
When the master reached Guoqing Monastery on Tiantai and saw Hanshan and Shide, he said, "Long have I heard of Hanshan and Shide;

text_zh: 師因到天台國清寺，見寒山、拾得，師云：「久響寒山、拾 得，到來只見兩頭水牯牛。」寒山、拾得便作牛鬥，師云： 「叱叱。」寒山、拾得咬齒相看，師便歸堂。二人來堂內，問 師：「適來因緣作麼生？」師乃呵呵大笑。
text_en: coming here, I see only two water buffaloes." Hanshan and Shide then acted out buffalo fighting. The master said, "Hey, hey!" Hanshan and Shide gnashed their teeth and glared at each other. The master returned to the hall. The two came into the hall and asked the master, "How about that earlier exchange?" The master just laughed loudly.
One day the two asked the master, "Where have you been?" The master said, "To bow to the five hundred arhats." The two

text_zh: 一日，二人問師：「什麼處去來？」師云：「禮拜五百尊者。」二 人云：「五百頭水牯牛聻尊者。」師云：「為什麼作五百頭 水牯牛去？」山云：「蒼天蒼天！」師呵呵大笑。
text_en: said, "Five hundred water buffaloes, and where are the arhats?" The master said, "Why did they become five hundred water buffaloes?" Hanshan said, "Blue heaven, blue heaven!" The master laughed loudly.
While on pilgrimage, the master met two hermitage masters. One was acting as a horn-haired page boy. The master greeted them, but the two

text_zh: 師行腳時，見二庵主。一人作ㄚ角童。師問訊，二人殊 不顧。來日早晨，ㄚ角童將一鐺飯來，放地上，分作三 分。庵主將席子近前坐。ㄚ角童亦將席近前，相對坐， 亦不喚師。師乃亦將席子近前坐。ㄚ童目顧於師，庵 主云：「莫言侵早起，更有夜行人。」師云：「何不教詔這行 者？」庵主云：「他是人家男女。」師云：「洎合放過。」ㄚ童便起， 顧視庵主，云：「多口作麼？」ㄚ童從此入山不見。
text_en: paid no attention at all. The next morning, the horn-haired boy brought a pot of rice, set it on the ground, and divided it into three portions. The hermitage master pulled his mat forward and sat. The boy also pulled his mat forward and sat facing him, still not inviting the master. The master then also pulled his mat forward and sat. The boy looked at the master, and the hermitage master said, "Do not say you rose early; there are travelers by night as well." The master said, "Why not have this traveler instructed?" The hermitage master said, "He is someone's son." The master said, "I should have let it pass." The boy then stood up, looked at the hermitage master, and said, "Why so much talk?" From then on the boy entered the mountains and was not seen again.
While the master was reading a sutra, the novice Wenyuan came in. The master glanced at him from the side over the sutra. The novice

text_zh: 師因看經次，沙彌文遠入來，師乃將經側視之。沙彌 乃出去。師隨後把住，云：「速道！速道！」文遠云：「阿彌陀佛！ 阿彌陀佛！」師便歸方丈。
text_en: then went out. The master followed and seized him, saying, "Speak quickly! Speak quickly!" Wenyuan said, "Amitabha! Amitabha!" The master then returned to the abbot's quarters.
When a novice boy came for interview, the master said to the attendant, "Tell him to go." The attendant told the boy,

text_zh: 因沙彌童行參，師向侍者道：「教伊去。」侍者向行者道： 「和尚教去。」師云：「沙彌童行得入門，侍者在門外。」
text_en: "The master says to go." The master said, "The novice boy gets in through the gate; the attendant stays outside the gate."
While traveling, the master came to the monastery of a senior master. As soon as he entered and they saw each other, he said, "Is there? Is there?"

text_zh: 師行腳時，到一尊宿院，才入門相見，便云：「有麼？有麼？」 尊宿豎起拳頭，師云：「水淺船難泊。」便出去。又到一院， 見尊宿，便云：「有麼？有麼？」尊宿豎起拳頭，師云：「能縱能 奪，能取能撮。」禮拜便出去。
text_en: The senior master raised his fist. The master said, "The water is shallow; the boat is hard to moor." He then went out. He went to another monastery, saw the senior master, and said, "Is there? Is there?" The senior master raised his fist. The master said, "Able to let go and able to seize, able to take and able to gather." He bowed and went out.
One day the master held up a string of beads and asked a Silla elder, "Do they also have this over there?" He said,

text_zh: 師一日拈數珠，問新羅長老：「彼中還有者箇也無？」云： 「有。」師云：「何似者箇？」云：「不似者箇。」師云：「既有，為什麼不 似？」無語。師自代云：「不見道新羅、大唐。」
text_en: "They do." The master said, "How is it compared with this?" He said, "It is not like this." The master said, "Since they have it, why is it not like this?" There was no reply. The master answered for him, saying, "Have you not heard: Silla and Great Tang."
He asked a newly arrived monk, "Where do you come from?" He said, "From the south!" The master raised a finger and said, "Do you understand?" He said, "I do not."

text_zh: 問新到：「什麼處來？」云：「南方來！」師豎起指，云：「會麼？」云：「不 會。」師云：「動止萬福。不會？」
text_en: The master said, "Ten thousand blessings in movement and stillness. You do not understand?"
While on pilgrimage, the master asked Daci, "What is prajna's substance?" Daci said, "What is prajna's

text_zh: 師行腳時，問大慈：「般若以何為體？」慈云：「般若以何為 體？」師便呵呵大笑而出。大慈來日見師掃地次，問：「般 若以何為體？」師放下掃帚，呵呵大笑而去。大慈便歸 方丈。
text_en: substance?" The master laughed loudly and left. The next day Daci saw the master sweeping and asked, "What is prajna's substance?" The master put down the broom, laughed loudly, and went away. Daci then returned to his quarters.
The master came to Baizhang. Baizhang asked, "Where do you come from?" He said, "From Nanquan." Baizhang said, "What

text_zh: 師到百丈，百丈問：「從什麼處來？」云：「南泉來。」百丈云：「南 泉有何言句示人？」師云：「有時道『未得之人亦須峭然 去。』」百丈叱之。師容愕然。百丈云：「大好峭然。」師便作舞 而出。
text_en: sayings does Nanquan use to instruct people?" The master said, "Sometimes he says, 'Even one who has not attained must still stand steeply forth.' " Baizhang shouted at him. The master's expression turned startled. Baizhang said, "Excellent, steep indeed." The master then danced and went out.
The master came to Touzi's place and sat facing him at the meal. Touzi gave him a steamed cake to eat. The master said, "I will not eat."

text_zh: 師到投子處，對坐齋。投子將蒸餅與師喫。師云：「不喫。」 不久下糊餅，投子教沙彌度與師。師接得餅，卻禮沙 彌三拜。投子默然。
text_en: Before long, griddle cakes were served, and Touzi had a novice pass one to the master. The master received the cake and then bowed to the novice three times. Touzi remained silent.
A monk painted the master's portrait and presented it to him. The master said, "If it looks like this old monk, then beat me to death; if it does not look like me,

text_zh: 因僧寫師真呈師，師云：「若似老僧，即打殺我；若不似， 即燒卻。」
text_en: then burn it."
As the master was walking with Wenyuan, he pointed with his hand to a patch of ground and said, "This would be a fine place to set up a

text_zh: 師因與文遠行次，乃以手指一片地，云：「這裏好造一 箇巡鋪子。」文遠便去彼中立，云：「把將公驗來。」師便打 一摑。遠云：「公驗分明過。」
text_en: patrol post." Wenyuan went and stood there, saying, "Bring your official pass!" The master then gave him a slap. Yuan said, "The pass was clearly in order."
The master asked a newly arrived monk, "Where have you just come from?" He said, "Mount Tai." The master said, "Did you see Manjusri there or not?" The monk

text_zh: 師問新到：「近離甚處？」云：「臺山。」師云：「還見文殊也無？」僧 展手。師云：「展手頗多，文殊誰睹？」云：「只守氣急殺人。」師 云：「不睹雲中鴈，焉知沙塞寒。」
text_en: spread out his hands. The master said, "Many can spread out their hands, but who has seen Manjusri?" He said, "Just guarding the breath in a murderous hurry." The master He said, If one does not see the geese in the clouds, how would one know the cold of the desert frontier.
A monk asked, I have come from far away to throw myself on the Master; I ask the Master to receive me. The Master said, Under Sun Bin, why drill a tortoise shell?

text_zh: 問：「遠遠投師，請師一接。」師云：「孫賓門下，因什麼鑽龜？」 僧拂袖出去。師云：「將為當榮，折他雙足。」
text_en: The monk flicked his sleeves and went out. The Master said, I had taken him for a worthy one, but he has broken both his legs.
The Master and the head monk were looking at the stone bridge. He then asked the head monk, Who built this? He said, Li Ying built it.

text_zh: 師與首座看石橋，乃問首座：「是什麼人造？」云：「李膺造。」 師云：「造時向什麼處下手？」無對。師云：「尋常說石橋，問 著下手處也不知。」
text_en: The Master said, When he built it, where did he set his hand to begin? There was no reply. The Master said, You ordinarily speak of the stone bridge, but when asked about the place where the work began, you do not even know.
The head monk of the Silla Monastery invited the Master for a meal. When the Master reached the gate, he asked, What monastery is this? He said, Silla

text_zh: 有新羅院主請師齋，師到門首，問：「此是什麼院？」云：「新 羅院。」師云：「我與你隔海。」
text_en: Monastery. The Master said, Between you and me lies an ocean.
The Master asked a monk, Where do you come from? He said, From Yunju. The Master said, What saying does Yunju have? He said:

text_zh: 問僧：「什麼處來？」云：「雲居來。」師云：「雲居有什麼言句？」云： 「僧問：『靈羊掛角時如何？』雲居云：『六六三十六。』」師云：「雲 居師兄由在。」僧卻問：「未審和尚尊意如何？」師云：「九九 八十一。」
text_en: A monk asked, What is it like when the spirit ram hangs its horns? Yunju said, Six sixes are thirty-six. The Master said, Yun ju, elder brother teacher, is still around. The monk then asked, I do not yet know Your Reverence's meaning. The Master said, Nine nines are eighty-one.
One evening an old woman came into the monastery. The Master said, What are you doing? The old woman said, Seeking lodging. The Master said:

text_zh: 有一婆子日晚入院來，師云：「作什麼？」婆云：「寄宿。」師云： 「者裏是什麼所在？」婆呵呵大笑而去。
text_en: What kind of place is this here? The old woman laughed heartily and left.
The Master went out and met an old woman carrying a basket. The Master then asked, Where are you

text_zh: 師出外，逢見一箇婆子提一箇籃子，師便問：「什麼處 去？」云：「偷趙州筍去。」師云：「忽見趙州，又作麼生？」婆子近 前，打一掌。
text_en: going? She said, Going to steal Zhaozhou's bamboo shoots. The Master said, If you suddenly met Zhaozhou, then what? The old woman stepped close and slapped him once.
The Master saw the monastery head bringing uncooked rice; when the crows saw him, they all flew off. The Master said, When the crows saw

text_zh: 師因見院主送生飯，鴉子見便總飛去，師云：「鴉子見 你為什麼卻飛去？」院主云：「怕專甲。」師云：「是什麼語話？」 師代云：「為某甲有殺心在。」
text_en: you, why did they fly away? The head monk said, They fear me. The Master said, What kind of talk is that? The Master answered in his place: Because I have a mind to kill.
The Master asked a monk, Where do you come from? He said, From Jiangxi. The Master said, Where is Zhaozhou located?

text_zh: 師問僧：「什麼處來？」云：「江西來。」師云：「趙州著在什麼處？」 僧無對。
text_en: The monk had no reply.
The Master was passing by the hall and saw a monk bowing. The Master struck him once with a staff and said, Bowing is also a good

text_zh: 師從殿上過，見一僧禮拜。師打一棒，云：「禮拜也是好 事。」師云：「好事不如無。」
text_en: thing. The Master said, A good thing is not as good as no thing.
When the Master visited Tong Pass, the guard at Tong Pass asked him, Do you know there is a Tong Pass or not? The Master said, I know

text_zh: 師因參潼關，潼關問師云：「你還知有潼關麼？」師云：「知 有潼關。」云：「有公驗者即得過，無公驗者不得過。」師云： 「忽遇鑾駕來時如何？」關云：「也須檢點過。」云：「你要造反。」 師到寶壽，寶壽見師來，遂乃背面而坐。師便展坐具。 寶壽起立，師便出去。
text_en: there is a Tong Pass. He said, Those with official papers may pass; those without official papers may not pass. The Master said: If the imperial carriage were suddenly to arrive, what then? The guard said, It too must be inspected before passing. He said, You want to rebel. The Master came to Baoshou. When Baoshou saw him coming, he turned his back and sat facing away. The Master then spread out his sitting cloth. Baoshou stood up, and the Master immediately went out.
When the Master was with Nanquan, Nanquan led a water buffalo into the monks' hall and made a circuit around the hall.

text_zh: 師在南泉時，泉牽一頭水牯牛，入僧堂內，巡堂而轉。 首座乃向牛背上三拍，泉便休去。師後將一束草安 首座面前，首座無對。
text_en: The head monk then slapped the buffalo's back three times, and Nanquan stopped and left. Later the Master placed a bundle of grass before the head monk, and the head monk had no reply.
A scholar saw the Master and praised him, saying, Reverend, you are an ancient Buddha. The Master said, Scholar, you are

text_zh: 有秀才見師，乃讚嘆師云：「和尚是古佛。」師云：「秀才是 新如來。」
text_en: a new Tathagata.
A monk asked, What is nirvana? The Master said, My hearing is poor. The monk asked again. The Master said, I am not

text_zh: 有僧問：「如何是涅槃？」師云：「我耳重。」僧再問，師云：「我不 害耳聾。」乃有頌：「騰騰大道者，對面涅槃門；但坐念無 際，來年春又春。」
text_en: bothered by deaf ears. Then he had a verse: Broad and easy is the Great Way, nirvana's gate is right before your face; just sit, thinking without limit, and next year spring will be spring again.
A monk asked, Are the two roads of life and death the same or different? The Master then had a verse: A wayfarer asks of life and death,

text_zh: 有僧問：「生死二路是同是別？」師乃有頌：「道人問生死， 生死若為論？雙林一池水，朗月耀乾坤。喚他句上識， 此是弄精魂。欲會箇生死，顛人說夢春。」
text_en: how can life and death be discussed? In Shuanglin, one pond of water; a bright moon shines over heaven and earth. To call that understanding upon the words, this is to toy with spirit and soul. If you wish to grasp life and death, it is like a madman speaking dream-spring.
A monk asked, When the Buddhas face trouble, they hide their bodies in flames; when the Reverend faces trouble, where

text_zh: 有僧問：「諸佛有難，火焰裏藏身；和尚有難，向什麼處 藏身？」師乃有頌：「渠說佛有難，我說渠有災；但看我避 難，何處有相隨。有無不是說，去來非去來；為你說難 法，對面識得未？」
text_en: do you hide your body? The Master then had a verse: He says the Buddha has trouble; I say he has disaster. Just watch how I avoid trouble, where is there any following along? Being and nonbeing are not the point, going and coming are not going and coming. For your sake I speak of the difficult Dharma, but face to face, have you recognized it yet?

text_zh: 偈頌十二時歌
text_en: Verses Song of the Twelve Hours At cockcrow, the Chou hour, sorrow comes when I get up and still look shabby. No skirt, no short jacket at all, only the form of a kasaya

text_zh: 雞鳴丑，愁見起來還漏逗。裙子褊衫箇也無，袈裟形 相些些有。褌無腰，褲無口，頭上青灰三五斗。北望修 行利濟人，誰知變作不唧溜。
text_en: barely remains. The loincloth has no waist, the trousers no opening, and on my head are three or five pecks of bluish ash. Looking north, I meant to practice and benefit people, but who knew I would end up in such a wretched state.
At dawn, the Yin hour, this ruined monastery in a desolate village is hard to speak of. For the morning gruel there is not a grain of rice, only facing empty

text_zh: 平旦寅，荒村破院實難論。解齋粥米全無粒，空對閑 窗與隙塵。唯雀噪，勿人親，獨坐時聞落葉頻。誰道出 家憎愛斷，思量不覺淚沾巾。
text_en: windows and dust in the cracks. Only sparrows chatter, no one draws near; sitting alone, I often hear falling leaves. Who says that leaving home cuts off love and hate? Thinking on it, without noticing, tears soak my cloth.
At sunrise, the Mao hour, purity itself turns into vexation. Conditioned merit is covered by dusty curtains, and endless fields

text_zh: 日出卯，清淨卻翻為煩惱。有為功德被塵幔，無限田 地未曾掃。攢眉多，稱心少，叵耐東村黑黃老。供利不 曾將得來，放驢喫我堂前草。
text_en: have never been swept. Much furrowing of brows, little to the heart's liking; unbearable are that black and yellow old ones from the east village. Offerings and support they never bring, yet they let their donkeys eat the grass before my hall.
At mealtime, the Chen hour, I vainly look to the neighboring houses for cooking smoke. I parted from steamed buns years ago; today I can only

text_zh: 趙州和尚語錄卷下終 趙州真際禪師行狀
text_en: Recorded Sayings of Reverend Zhaozhou, Lower Scroll End. Biographical Record of Chan Master Zhenji of Zhaozhou The Master was a disciple in Nanquan's lineage. His secular surname was Hao, originally from Hao Village in Caozhou; his personal name was Cong

text_zh: 師即南泉門人也。俗姓郝氏，本曹州郝鄉人也，諱從 諗。鎮府有塔記云：「師得七百甲子歟！值武王微沐，避 地岨崍，木食草衣，僧儀不易。」師初隨本師行腳到南 泉。本師先人事了，師方乃人事。南泉在方丈內臥次， 見師來參，便問：「近離什麼處？」師云：「瑞像院。」南泉云：「還 見瑞像麼？」師云：「瑞像即不見，即見臥如來。」南泉乃起 問：「你是有主沙彌，無主沙彌？」師對云：「有主沙彌。」泉云： 「那箇是你主？」師云：「孟春猶寒，伏惟和尚尊體起居萬 福。」泉乃喚維那云：「此沙彌別處安排。」師受戒後，聞受 業師在曹州西，住護國院，乃歸院省覲。到後，本師令 郝氏云：「君家之子，遊方已迴。」其家親屬忻懌不已，秖 候來日，咸往觀焉。師聞之，乃云：「俗塵愛網，無有了期。 已辭出家，不願再見。」乃於是夜結束前邁。其後自攜 瓶錫，遍歷諸方。常自謂曰：「七歲童兒勝我者，我即問 伊；百歲老翁不及我者，我即教佗。」年至八十，方住趙 州城東觀音院，去石橋十里。已來住持枯槁，志效古 人。僧堂無前後架，旋營齋食；繩床一腳折，以燒斷薪 用繩繫之。每有別制新者，師不許也。住持四十來年， 未嘗齎一封書告其檀越。因有南方僧來，舉：問雪峰 「古澗寒泉時如何？」雪峰云：「瞪目不見底。」學云：「飲者如 何？」峰云：「不從口入。」師聞之曰：「不從口入，從鼻孔裏入。」 其僧卻問師：「古澗寒泉時如何？」師云：「苦。」學云：「飲者如 何？」師云：「死。」雪峰聞師此語，讚云：「古佛，古佛！」雪峰因此， 後不答話矣。厥後因河北燕王領兵收鎮府，既到界 上，有觀氣象者奏曰：「趙州有聖人所居，戰必不勝。」燕 趙二王，因展筵會，俱息交鋒。乃問：「趙之金地，上士何 人？」或曰：「有講《華嚴經》大師，節行孤邈。若歲大旱，咸命 往臺山祈禱。大師未迴，甘澤如瀉。」乃曰：「恐未盡善。」或 云：「此去一百二十里，有趙州觀音院。有禪師，年臘高 邈，道眼明白。」僉曰：「此可應兆乎！」二王稅駕觀焉。既屆 院內，師乃端坐不起。燕王遂問曰：「人王尊耶？法王尊 耶？」師云：「若在人王，人王中尊；若在法王，法王中尊。」燕 王唯然矣。師良久中間問：「阿那箇是鎮府大王。」趙王 應喏：「弟子。」緣趙州屬鎮府，以表知重之禮。師云：「老僧濫在山河，不及 趍面。」須臾，左右請師為大王說法，師云：「大王左右多， 爭交老僧說法。」乃約令左右退。師身畔時有沙彌文 遠，高聲云：「啟大王，不是者箇左右。」大王乃問：「是什麼 左右？」對曰：「大王尊諱多，和尚所以不敢說法。」燕王乃 云：「請禪師去諱說法。」師云：「故知大王曩劫眷屬，俱是 冤家。我佛世尊，一稱名號，罪滅福生。大王先祖，才有 人觸著名字，便生嗔怒。」師慈悲非倦說法多時，二王 稽首讚嘆，珍敬無盡。來日將迴，燕王下先鋒使，聞師 不起，凌晨入院，責師傲兀君侯。師聞之，乃出迎接。先 鋒乃問曰：「昨日見二王來不起，今日見某甲來，因何 起接？」師云：「待都衙得似大王，老僧亦不起接。」先鋒聆 師此語，再三拜而去。尋後，趙王發使，取師供養。既屆 城門，闔城威儀，迎之入內。師才下寶輦，王乃設拜，請 師上殿，正位而坐。師良久以手斫額云：「階下立者是 何官長？」左右云：「是諸院尊宿并大師、大德。」師云：「他各 是一方化主，若在階下，老僧亦起。」王乃命上殿。是日 齋筵將罷，僧官排定，從上至下，一人一問。一人問佛 法，師既望見，乃問：「作什麼？」云：「問佛法。」師云：「這裏已坐 卻老僧，那裏問什麼法？二尊不並化。」此乃語之詞也王乃令 止。其時國后與王俱在左右侍立。國后云：「請禪師為 大王摩頂受記。」師以手摩大王頂云：「願大王與老僧 齊年。」是時迎師權在近院駐泊，獲時選地，建造禪宮。 師聞之，令人謂王曰：「若動著一莖草，老僧卻歸趙州。」 其時竇行軍願捨果園一所，直一萬五千貫，號為真 際禪院，亦云竇家園也。師入院後，海眾雲臻。是時趙 王禮奉，燕王從幽州奏到命服，鎮府具威儀迎接。師 堅讓不受。左右舁箱至師面前云：「大王為禪師佛法 故，堅請師著此衣。」師云：「老僧為佛法故，所以不著此 衣。」左右云：「且看大王面。」師云：「又干俗官什麼事！」乃躬 自取衣挂身上，禮賀再三，師惟知應喏而已。師住趙 州二年，將謝世時，謂弟子曰：「吾去世之後，焚燒了，不 用淨淘舍利。宗師弟子不同浮俗，且身是幻，舍利何 生，斯不可也。令小師送拂子一枝與趙王，傳語云：『此 是老僧一生用不盡底。』」師於戊子歲十一月十日端 坐而終。于時竇家園，道俗車馬數萬餘人，哀聲振動 原野。趙王於時盡送終之禮，感歎之泣，無異金棺匿 彩於俱尸矣，莫不高營鴈塔，特豎豐碑，諡號曰真際 禪師光祖之塔。後唐保大十一年孟夏月旬有三日， 有學者咨問東都東院惠通禪師，趙州先人行化厥 由。作禮而退，乃授筆錄之。具實矣！
text_en: shen. A pagoda inscription in Zhenfu says: Did the Master reach seven hundred jiazi cycles? When King Wu was in decline, he withdrew to avoid the times in remote mountains, eating roots and wearing grass, yet the deportment of a monk did not change. At first the Master traveled with his original teacher and came to Nan quan. His original teacher first completed the formal greetings; only then did the Master make his greeting. Nanquan was lying in the abbot's room, and when he saw the Master come to visit, he asked, From where have you lately come? The Master said, Ruixiang Monastery. Nanquan said, Did you see the auspicious image? The Master said, The auspicious image I did not see, but I did see a reclining Tathagata. Nanquan then got up and asked, Are you a novice with a master, or a novice without a master? The Master replied, A novice with a master. Nanquan said: Which one is your master? The Master said, Though it is early spring and still cold, I respectfully wish Your Reverence's honored body peace and ten thousand blessings. Nanquan then called the steward and said, Arrange another place for this novice. After the Master received full ordination, he heard that his ordination teacher was west of Caozhou, residing at Huguo Monastery, so he returned there to pay respects. After he arrived, his original teacher ordered the Hao family, saying: Your son has returned from wandering among teachers. His relatives were overjoyed beyond measure and only waited for the next day, all planning to come see him. When the Master heard this, he said: The dusty net of worldly affection has no end. I have already left home; I do not wish to meet them again. That very night he packed up and went on ahead. Afterward he himself carried his bottle and staff and traveled everywhere. He often said of himself: If a seven-year-old child surpasses me, I will ask him; if a hundred-year-old old man is not equal to me, I will teach him. Not until he was eighty did he settle at Zhao zhou, at Guanyin Monastery east of the city, ten li from the stone bridge. Thereafter his abbacy was austere and spare, his resolve was to emulate the ancients. In the monks' hall there were no front or rear platforms; meals were arranged only as needed. One leg of his rope bed was broken, so he used a burnt piece of firewood and tied it on with rope. Whenever someone made a new one for him, the Master would not permit it. For more than forty years as abbot, he never once sent a single letter to solicit his patrons. Then a monk from the south came and quoted a question to Xuefeng: What is it like when an ancient ravine has a cold spring? Xuefeng said, Stare with wide eyes and you cannot see the bottom. The student said, For one who drinks it, how is it? Xuefeng said, It does not enter through the mouth. When the Master heard this, he said: If not through the mouth, then it enters through the nostrils. That monk then asked the Master, What is it like when an ancient ravine has a cold spring? The Master said, Bitter. The student said, For one who drinks it, how is it? The Master said, Dead. When Xuefeng heard the Master's words, he praised him, saying: Ancient Buddha, ancient Buddha. Because of this, Xuefeng afterward no longer answered such questions. Later, when the King of Yan in Hebei led troops to take Zhenfu, once they reached the border a reader of omens reported: In Zhaozhou there dwells a sage; if you fight, you will surely not win. Yan and Zhao, the two kings, thereupon spread a banquet and both ceased hostilities. Then they asked: In Zhao's golden land, what superior man is there? Someone said: There is a great master who lectures on the Avatamsaka Sutra, lofty and solitary in conduct. In years of great drought, all command him to go to Mount Tai to pray. Before the master returns, sweet rain pours down. They said: I fear this is not yet the very best. Someone said: One hundred twenty li from here is Zhaozhou Guanyin Monastery. There is a Chan master there, advanced in years and seniority, with clear Dharma eye. All said: This one may fit the omen. The two kings halted their carriages and went to see him. Once they arrived in the monastery, the Master sat upright and did not rise. The King of Yan then asked: Which is more honored, the king of men or the Dharma King? The Master said: If among kings of men, the king of men is honored; if among Dharma kings, the Dharma King is honored. Yan King assented. After a while the Master asked: Which one is the great king of Zhenfu? The King of Zhao responded: Your disciple. The Master said: This old monk idly remains in the mountains and rivers and has not been able Because Zhaozhou was affiliated with the prefectural government, this was done to express due respect. to come face you. After a moment, attendants asked the Master to teach Dharma for the great king. The Master said: The great king has many attendants, how can they let this old monk speak Dharma? So they ordered the attendants to withdraw. At the Master's side there was a novice, Wen yuan, who said loudly: Inform the great king, these are not the attendants in question. The great king then asked: What attendants are those? He replied: The great king has many taboo names, so the Reverend does not dare speak Dharma. The King of Yan then said: I ask the Chan master to set aside the taboos and teach Dharma. The Master said: From this I know that the great king's relatives in former kalpas were all enemies. Our Buddha, the World-Honored One, when his name is spoken once, sins are extinguished and blessings arise. But your royal ancestors, as soon as someone touches upon their names, anger arises. The Master's compassion did not tire; he taught Dharma for a long time. The two kings bowed their heads and praised him, honoring him without end. The next day, when they were about to return, the King of Yan sent a vanguard envoy, who heard that the Master did not rise, and at dawn entered the monastery to accuse the Master of arrogance toward the lords. When the Master heard this, he came out to greet him. The vanguard then asked: Yesterday, when the two kings came, you did not rise; today, when you see me come, why did you rise to greet me? The Master said: When the commander becomes equal to a great king, this old monk also will not rise to greet him. The vanguard, hearing the Master's words, bowed again and again and left. Soon after, the King of Zhao sent messengers to invite the Master for offerings. When he arrived at the city gate, the whole city in formal array received him and escorted him inside. As soon as the Master descended from the jeweled carriage, the king bowed and invited the Master up to the hall, where he sat in the proper seat. After a while, the Master struck his forehead with his hand and said: Those standing below the steps, what officials are they? The attendants said: They are honored elders of the various monasteries, along with great masters and senior worthies. The Master said: Each of them is a teaching host in his own place. If they remain below the steps, this old monk will also rise. The king then ordered them up into the hall. That day as the feast was about to end, the monastic officials lined up, and from top to bottom each person was to ask one question. One person asked about Buddha Dharma. As soon as the Master saw him, he asked: What are you doing? He said: Asking about Buddha Dharma. The Master said: Here you have already seated this old monk aside; where then are you asking what Dharma? Two honored ones do not teach side by side. The king then ordered This is a word used in the wording. it stopped. At that time the queen and the king were both standing in attendance at his sides. The queen said: I ask the Chan master to, for The great king receives the prediction with a touch on the crown. The Master rubbed the great king's crown with his hand and said, May Your Majesty and this old monk have the same span of years. At that time, when arrangements were made to receive the Master, he was temporarily lodged in a nearby monastery, and in due time a site was chosen to build a Chan monastery. When the Master heard of it, he had someone tell the king, If a single blade of grass is disturbed, this old monk will return to Zhaozhou. At that time, Commander Dou vowed to donate an orchard, worth fifteen thousand strings of cash, to be named Zhenji Chan Monastery, also called the Dou Family Garden. After the Master entered the monastery, the assembly gathered like clouds from the sea. At that time the Prince of Zhao offered reverential support, and the Prince of Yan sent from Youzhou ceremonial robes bestowed by decree. The prefectural authorities prepared full honors to receive him. The Master firmly declined and would not accept them. Attendants carried the chest before the Master and said, For the sake of the Chan Master's Buddha Dharma, the great king earnestly asks the Master to wear these robes. The Master said, It is precisely for the sake of the Buddha Dharma that this old monk does not wear these robes. The attendants said, At least do it for the great king's sake. The Master said, What concern is it of worldly officials! Then he personally took the robe and draped it on himself. They bowed and offered congratulations again and again, and the Master merely acknowledged them. The Master stayed in Zhaozhou for two years. When he was about to leave the world, he told his disciples, After I pass away, cremate me, and do not wash and sort the relics. The disciples of a lineage master are not like the superficial customs of the world. Besides, the body is an illusion, so what relics could there be to produce? This must not be done. He ordered a young attendant monk to send one whisk to the Prince of Zhao, with the message: This is what this old monk could not use up in a lifetime. On the tenth day of the eleventh month in the year of wuzi, the Master sat upright and died. At that time, at the Dou Family Garden, there were tens of thousands of monks and laypeople with carts and horses, and their cries of grief shook the plains and fields. The Prince of Zhao carried out all the funeral rites, weeping with sorrow and lamentation, no different from when the golden coffin was concealed in splendor at Kusinagara. All raised a lofty wild-goose stupa and specially erected a grand stele, bestowing the posthumous title Zhenji Chan Master, and Guangzu Stupa. On the thirteenth day of the first summer month in the eleventh year of Baoda of the Later Tang, a student consulted Chan Master Huitong of the Eastern Monastery in the Eastern Capital about the causes and course of the former man's teaching activity in Zhaozhou. He bowed and withdrew, then took up the brush and recorded it. It is fully factual.
